title: Porsche Design Chronograph 911 GT3 RS
description: Exclusive timepiece powered by the COSC-certified Porsche Design caliber WERK 01.200 with flyback function. Titanium case with black titanium carbide coating and winding rotor modelled on the GT3 RS lightweight forged rim.

title: Porsche Motorsport Softshell Team Jacket
description: Official team jacket of the Porsche Motorsport Works Team. Windproof and waterproof technical fabric with reflective Porsche branding and sponsor logos.

title: Collector Diecast Model: 911 GT3 RS 1:18 (Guards Red)
description: High-detail resin model in 1:18 scale. Features genuine interior carpeting, steerable front wheels, opening doors, and accurate aerodynamic Weissach aero package reproduction.

title: Porsche Design Sunglasses P´8478 Iconic Aviator
description: The world's first sunglasses with an interchangeable lens system. Ultra-light pure titanium frame and polycarbonate lenses with scratch-resistant coating and 100% UV protection.

title: Roadster Hardcase Trolley M - Dark Titanium
description: Robust and lightweight polycarbonate luggage engineered to perfectly fit into the front luggage compartment of all Porsche 911 and 718 models. Features ball-bearing wheels and TSA lock.

title: Porsche 911 Soundbar 2.0 Pro - Original Exhaust
description: 2.1.2 virtual surround system crafted from the original exhaust system of the current Porsche 911 GT3. 300 watts system output, Dolby Atmos, 4K HDMI pass-through and Apple AirPlay 2.
